description: Free `*.warpweb.app` subdomain sites auto-pause after 7 days of inactivity. This call bumps `last_refreshed_at = now()` and, if currently paused, restores the live bundle on Cloudflare Pages. It's idempotent and free — safe to retry. Custom-domain sites stay live regardless and do not need this call (they pay $10/site/month for always-on hosting).
name: refresh_site
title: Refresh a free-subdomain Warpweb site
